description: The one bare-IID golden fixture: the pipeline contract transcribed from the fixture runner's header (the runner needs a database and was not executed) plus everything the pure reference functions (parser, scheme registry, classification registry, identity ladder, anchor builder, atom-id) say about the same IID.

expected.raw_type_rule: raw_type stays 'iid' and the node's iid column carries the validated canonical id
expected.search_text_rule: no identifier in search text until enrichment
expected.classification_type_rule: from the IID classification registry; isrc is an unambiguous scheme

transcribed.purpose: Drive ONE bare-IID atom through the real knowledge-graph worker pipeline (parse → classification → enrichment) and assert the golden contract below.

contract.raw_type_rule: raw_type stays 'iid' and the node's iid column carries the validated canonical id
contract.search_text_rule: no identifier in search text until enrichment
contract.classification_type_rule: from the IID classification registry; isrc is an unambiguous scheme

runModes.default: spawn local workers for each stage
runModes.--reset: delete the fixture atom (artifacts + moderation changes + node) before recreating it so it reprocesses from scratch
runModes.--cluster: do not spawn local workers; wait for the cluster's deployed workers to claim and complete each stage

transcribed.safety: Requires a loopback database URL; writes exactly one content-addressed fixture atom and leaves it in place; re-runs are idempotent (a node whose stages already completed is re-verified, not re-processed).
transcribed.executedNote: The fixture runner needs a database and was not run; only its header contract was transcribed.
